scenes.scope: Cutscene script s01; all supported END-terminated messages, including the Yorozuya opening, Otose and Catherine, the Shinsengumi encounter, Hijikata and Ayame. Unsupported read-only records remain unchanged.
notes: Unofficial fan translation of Gintama: Gintoki vs. Hijikata!? Kabukichou Gintama Dai Soudatsusen!! (Nintendo DS). I do not own Gintama or the original game. No affiliation, endorsement or permission from the rights holders is implied. Use only legally obtained ROMs; piracy is discouraged. See RIGHTS.md for rights and licensing limits.
Otsu’s abrupt word endings are deliberate jokes. Gin Tama terminology and the deliberate Shinichi misnaming are retained.
The Gin/kin exchange is a silver/gold pun that turns into a testicle joke. Gin is retained where the original repeats the first half of Gin Tama.

Even Katsura
can't handle this
on his own!

That's it, Gin! Let's ask
Hijikata and the
Shinsengumi for help!

This is no time
for that! Our country
is in danger!

That's the Gin I know!
All right, then...

Why haven't we
lost our motivation
like everyone else...?

Hey!
What are you guys
doing here?

A culprit? What
trouble is it now?

Keep this up
and I really will
hurt you.

The strongest, huh?
Interesting.
You're on.

Whatever. Just
take proper care
of your pet.

Forget it...
I was an idiot
for humoring you...

So, what were
the guys who beat
you up like?

A bunch of
ronin types, huh...

I'll look into it
while I'm working.

You're the ones
who lost, damn it.

Tch...!
I'm off my game today...

Ow! Something
just flew at me...!

Hold on!
This is a bomb?

See! I knew
he did it!

, he's tough.
We should take him
on together.

Then say so
in the first place!

Need a wig?
Try a hat shop.

I don't know
where he is.

Hmph!
I'll let you off
today.

I'll win next time!
Don't forget it!

We're looking for
a culprit, not work.

Well, not exactly
beaten to a pulp...

When did this
turn into a fight!?

A dog caring for you?
Pathetic!

I knew that
from the start.

I'm the one
who got attacked.

I know Hijikata
isn't the culprit.

They don't even
sell wigs at hat shops.

and he might be
friends. Or enemies...

But I think
they looked like
a bunch of ronin.

Not a game!
It was a real robbery!

No way...
We won...
Now what...?

It's got a dumb face,
but it's a real bomb!

Right...
We shut this
place down.

Perfect place
to plot something,
though.

They brought in
a whole load of

If something this big
explodes outside,

We've gotta disable
its detonator,
or we're screwed!

Don't tell me...
He ran away!

You've gotta be kidding...
You don't have to
tell me to leave!

What the hell!?
The elevator doors
won't open!

Then whatever it takes,
I'm not letting
this thing outside!

Even if it blows up
here, the damage above
should be limited.

Now we just need
a way out...

Wasn't this
an illegal
fighting ring...?

It's supposed to
have been sealed off
ever since.

to get rid of
the Amanto?

Found him,
but he got away...

That idiot
got in my way.
Couldn't talk to him.

Next time I see him,
he's gonna pay.

Might be too late
by then.

Question is,
what's our next move...?

The old man has
his position
to think about...

might slip up,
but we have to wait...

Even if we
handle it ourselves,

parts:
Ugh... Teaming up with them
isn't exactly my idea of fun...

I know!
...The whole planet's in danger.

You're still going on
about that?!

...And the key is at
the Banbanji's base?

If there's a chance,
let's take it!

Hmph! Debt or favor,
whatever. Do what you want.
But I'll tell you one thing.
You owe me one for this.

Until you've paid me back
in full... stay alive!

This is the catastrophe
you were talking about?!

We can't just sit here
watching it happen!

What's gloomy about me?
And it's Katsura, not Zura!

Yes. Far simpler and safer
than using brute force.

But if we storm
the enemy's base, perhaps...

If that quake and lightning
are tied to this crisis...

Then its epicenter must hold
the key to stopping it!

Yes. And what's there
is probably...

The ultimate weapon
for invading Earth!!

That's probably what's
causing this mass lethargy.

Sorry... I can't go
with you right now.

I have a debt to repay.
...A very great debt.

This crisis must be caused
by Kotodama energy
released from Gin Tama.

Katsura seems
to be all right...

If everyone in a country
loses the will to act...
You're the one who ran away!
You want a piece of me?!

I win.
Now stay out of our way!

Who's evil?! You're
working for the Banbanji!

Never said that, idiot!
Betraying your friends...
I'm let down!

Hey! Winning doesn't mean
you can make stuff up!

What facts?! You're
a Banbanji lackey!

What was that?!
Want another round, bastard?!

Hey! Winning doesn't mean
you can make stuff up!

What facts?! You're
a Banbanji lackey!

What was that?!
Want another round, bastard?!

Betraying your friends...
I'm disappointed in you!

I win.
Now stay out of our way!

Who's evil?!
Betraying your friends...
I'm disappointed in you!

I didn't betray anyone!
When did I ever
get in their way?!

Mistaking me for someone
else is a real pain.

This bastard got in our way
and said so himself!

The Banbanji, obviously!
They're trying to confuse us.

But just this once,
I'll put up with you
and join forces.

Whoa... Here comes
the real welcome party.

This time, we're settling
this once and for all!

You're in OUR way!
Working for the bad guys!

Quit that nonsense!
You said so yourself
a minute ago!

You said so yourself
a minute ago!

You're in OUR way!
Working for the bad guys!

He got in our way
and said so himself!

Teaming up with
this bastard isn't
my idea of fun...

You're the ones who
joined the enemy!

Why would Gin-chan
work for the Banbanji?

The real ones are
confusing enough!

China girl joined
the enemy too?!

We'll never save Edo
at this rate.

We'll never save Edo
at this rate.

Our stories don't
quite add up.

Hijikata's been with us
this whole time.

The boss who blocked us
was a different color too.

Will you two
cut it out already?!

Will you two
cut it out already?!

Odd... Gin's been with us
this whole time.

Now that you mention it...
Their colors were different.

Hijikata, let's join forces
and save Edo!
Small fry are taken care of.

You know how this works.
The boss is always
on the top floor.

Who knows? Shinsengumi,
search the even floors.

What? Got a problem,
you bastard?!
This jerk's no friend of mine!

Then we'll take
the odd floors.

You're Shinsengumi's
vice-chief. In other words,
number two.

I run the Yorozuya.
I'm the president.
Number one!

One is odd, so we
take the odd floors.

Shut up, number two!
Get to floor two!

Quit showing off.
Everyone knows that.

Hey, hold it!
Who put you in charge?

Oh, really?
Let's hear your reason.

Poor staff, working
for an idiot like you.

The real enemy
is in the tower!

Yorozuya takes
the odd floors, then.

Otaeee!!
I'm here to save you!!

Come on, Toshi!
Otae's waiting for me!

Just hired muscle,
bought with cash.

Either way, we should
split into two teams.

How many floors
does this tower have?

Please, both of you,
calm down already!

Oh, right...
Gin owns the Yorozuya.

Yes! Thanks to me,
Edo... no, this planet
is safe once more!

As if! Help that
mayo freak?!

What, old hag?!
Knock before you barge
into my house!

Huh? You said
the rent could wait...

Just a little longer!
I'm nearly there!

Heh heh heh...
This! Look closely,
my dear Shinpachi.

Wrong, idiot.
Take a closer look.

Exactly! Two more,
and any wish
will come true!

Then I'll pay it all!
Rent, wages,
whatever you want!

Right, I promised!
I'll buy you
a year's supply.

...So there you have it,
old hag.

Why not? I'll pay
ten years in advance!

Crap! Shinpachi!
Kagura! Run for it!

Just wait for ten years
of rent, you old hag!!

The Orb legend
is unrelated to
the Banbanji plot.

So collecting them
really does
grant wishes!

Let the rent wait
until I find
two more Dragon Orbs.

Pay your rent before
you call it your house!

I said I'd wait
for ONE month
of rent!

What's unfair about
collecting rent you owe?!

Forget ten years!
Try paying even
one month first!

How many months
will you owe me?!

No, not that...
We solved the case, right?

What are you saying?
Hijikata, Hiraga...
Everyone helped!

Nearly there? With what?
Savings? No way
you'd have any...

Huh? What is it?
...Wait! These are...!

Dragon Orbs?!
And you have... five?!

You still believe that?!
But Gin Tama were
the Banbanji's...

No... That's not
even a syllogism.

Gin! Run away?!
What are you going to do?!

Shut up! I'll beat you
and get a personality!

We won!
We beat the hero!!

At least call me
by my name!

Yeah! Nobody'll call us
small fry ever again!

From now on, we'll
take over as...

Come on, then!
Let's get this over with!

I'll finish before
that mayo freak!

More of them?
Tch. Bland as ever!

Dream on!
Let's settle this
with Gin Tama!

The hero can't lose
to nameless grunts!

Take that, evil
henchmen one and two!

N-no way! Me, losing
to grunts like these?!

Listen. If I,
the hero, lose...

Then it's game over.
Those are the rules.

You'll never, ever
be the leads!

Before you complain,
get yourselves
some proper names.

Best to finish
grunt fights fast!

Fine by me, but
since you won...

Take responsibility
and wrap this up!

Well, can't blame you.
Guess there's no choice.

In times like these,
just call it
a game over.

Like I care
about your problems.

I don't even want
to talk anymore.

...Let's just fight
and get it over with!

There it is!
The classic grunt line!

Oh, even the second
classic line!

Huh? Oh! Hiraga?!
What are you doing here?

Those guys aren't
a toy company!

Banbanji are pirates
out to conquer Earth!

Gin Tama were
one of their tools!

Idiot! This isn't
a branch office...
Hey! Listen!

Didn't you lose contact
with them after
delivering the Gin Tama?

Wasn't that
what you told me?

It's on the card?!
Are you an idiot?!

Before you find them,
find the business card
they gave you!

Don't "right" me!
That tower is dangerous.

It seems to be
the pirates' base.

Leave storming it to me.
You go home, old man.

If anything happens
to you, who's going
to oil Saburo?

I'll settle your score
with them too, old man.

What? Gin Tama?
Why give me these?

Hmm. Don't quite get it,
but I'll take them.

Too much trouble.
Let's just call it
a game over.

Hey, isn't that
the Yorozuya lad?!

Why? Remember
what I told you before?

About the toy company
that ordered Gin Tama.

Damn! They tricked me
into helping them?!

I forgot they'd
given me a business card.

When I delivered the orbs,
they refused
to accept these.

One look, and they
started yelling that
these were useless.

Tell them to pay
what they owe me!

We've got identities
of our own!

Yeah! We're members
of the space pirates,
the Banbanji!

You got us!
The hero's strong!

What now?
Uh... what DO we do?

W-what? Is it wrong
for us to win?!

Yeah! Oh, just
to be clear...

Those Inui and
Chatoran you might have
met in earlier chapters...

Yeah. We can't beat
anyone with a name.

Hey, we won!
What do we do now?!

We're just grunts
whose job is to lose.

I don't know
how to celebrate!

I don't know
how to wrap this up!!

Damn you...
Don't think you've won...

Damn it!
You'll pay for this!!

Don't say "still"!
It's finally our turn!

At least let us
introduce ourselves...

Damn it!
You'll pay for this!!

That's it?!
No lingering sense
of victory?!

Who do you think
saved your life?!

Taking money
from your savior?
Some nerve you've got!

Get it? Good.
Now go home.

You were being
controlled by
space pirates, old hag!

Your life's only worth
one month of rent?!
That's cheap...

How should I know?!
...Find a part-time job!

Ungrateful old hag!
Heaven will punish you!!

Life gets cheaper
when you're nearly dead?

...Is that all
you have to say?

And I'm properly
grateful for it,
aren't I?

My thanks is
one month's free rent!
What more do you want?

But you'll pay
every last yen
of the rest!

We looked after you
when you were
unconscious, Otose.

Surely you
at least remember that?

The damage has spread
all over Kabukicho.

Us using them now
won't make much difference.

All right.
Let's see how it goes.

Before that,
have you got a moment?

Is it all right
to use them?

Hope he hasn't
turned into a total bum.

Maybe we'll finally
get names now!

I wish we'd at least
had proper names...

Even grunts like us
can win if we try!!

Seriously... Why are
grunt characters
always so bland?

Try all you want.
You'll never do it.
So hurry up and get lost!!

Grunts trying
so hard to stand out
are just pathetic.

Too much hassle.
Can we ignore them?

You guys should
find new jobs.

Now cat aliens
and dog aliens...?

There, it's over.
Now get lost!

Shut up!!
I've heard enough of that!

Model grunts.
They even got their
parting threats right.

Shut up!
Just not being human
makes us stand out!

What?! That's it!
I've had enough!

Damn... We lost,
but more of our kind...

Want into the tower?
Then fight us!

More and more of us
will come after you!

Um... We didn't
mean to win...

Please... Next time,
we'll be proper grunts.

We lost...
Can't beat
the main characters.

Oh, crap...
What do we do...?

We're just grunts...
We're really sorry...

Even the shogunate
has gone soft.

Let's show them
our unbroken
samurai spirit!

Don't worry.
Edo has us,
the Shinsengumi.

Hey, have you
gone soft now too?
are all the rage in Edo.

They seem harmless.
The shogunate
turns a blind eye.

Speaking of which,
what's the boss
up to right now?

Now this is
more like it!
